mapper.select: SELECT c.circle_id, c.name, c.logo_url, c.description, COALESCE(ac.album_count, 0) AS album_count, c.member_count, la.latest_album_date FROM circles c LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS album_count FROM album_circles ac2 WHERE ac2.circle_id = c.circle_id ) ac ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT MAX(a.publish_date) AS latest_album_date FROM albums a JOIN album_circles ac3 ON a.album_id = ac3.album_id WHERE ac3.circle_id = c.circle_id ) la ON true ORDER BY c.circle_id

SELECT c.circle_id, c.name, c.logo_url, c.description, COALESCE(ac.album_count, 0) AS album_count, c.member_count, la.latest_album_date FROM circles c LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS album_count FROM album_circles ac2 WHERE ac2.circle_id = c.circle_id ) ac ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT MAX(a.publish_date) AS latest_album_date FROM albums a JOIN album_circles ac3 ON a.album_id = ac3.album_id WHERE ac3.circle_id = c.circle_id ) la ON true ORDER BY c.circle_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.avatar_url, u.user_role FROM users u JOIN user_circles uc ON u.user_id = uc.user_id WHERE uc.circle_id = #{circle_id} ORDER BY u.user_id
SELECT circle_id FROM user_circles WHERE user_id = #{user_id}
